groups.defect: Failed device admission leaves a cache entry that lets subsequent requests bypass the device limit.
groups.rationale: Both describe caching the device before persistence succeeds and then skipping enforcement on retries. One points at error propagation and the other at cache population; fixing cache handling resolves both.

groups.defect: Non-atomic device counting and insertion allow concurrent registrations to exceed the configured limit.
groups.rationale: Both identify the same count-then-write race in the same code block and require atomic enforcement of admission.
